author: Ogrey
body:
Hey guys, bringin' ya all another map, this time from me and UniqueAir (My taurus friend :D).
Well, the map itself is some sort of floating village holding 3 medieval styled houses with 4 windmills on it, 2 of those windmills being the monuments. The map's first windmill is packed with redstone resources to enable TNT cannoning, and the last windmill at the very far island contains chests with gunpowder and sand, god knows what for!
You should be able to shoot TNT from your bows as well, and at the same time make some deadly TNT with the previously mentioned redstone resources and sand & gunpowder.
Hope you all enjoy this map, more updates coming to it as gameplay is put to test :)

Map Name: Windmill Plains
Map Authors: Evocal & UniqueAir
Gamemode: DTM (Destroy the Monument)
Team Sizes:
- Sun Village (Yellow) - 40 players
- Moon Village (Cyan) - 40 players
Map Pictures:

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Looks pretty freakin' awesome Evo. 'Bout time you made a TNT map you bugger! 

I only have a few suggestions:
  • I suggest making the bows just shoot normal arrows, if they strike a scatter... then... I guess they'd be pretty OP. 
  • Make under the islands bigger, since there will be TNT, the islands will go to void in a moderate time length. And we wouldn't want that... unless you disable TNT block damage.

Anyway, as always your map looks sexy! +1
